description: v1.9.0 SLO baseline for the Ethics AI module. Covers ETH-1..ETH-6: single-school decision (ETH-1), five-school batch decision (ETH-2), 512-token vector semantic search (ETH-3), batch-10 context build (ETH-4), multi-round debate continuation (ETH-5), and metrics recording overhead (ETH-6). All benchmarks in bench_ethics_ai_plugin.cpp.

ETH-1.label: Single Argument Generation P95
ETH-1.note: Measures full makeDecision() pipeline for one philosophy school (Kantian) including argument generation, RAG context retrieval, and decision scoring. SLO ETHG-1: p95 ≤ 60 ms (excl. LLM backend).

ETH-2.label: Batch 5 Arguments (parallel, 5 Schulen)
ETH-2.note: Measures makeDecision() pipeline with five philosophy schools (Kant, utilitarianism, Rawls, contractualism, Socratic). SLO ETHG-2: p99 ≤ 140 ms.

ETH-3.label: Embedding Latenz (512-Token, CPU)
ETH-3.note: Measures vectorSemanticSearch() with a 512-token query on the in-memory argument store. Uses term-overlap cosine proxy (real embedding injection via setEmbeddingFn() is Q3 2026). SLO: p99 ≤ 200 ms on CPU.

ETH-4.label: Batch 10 Queries
ETH-4.note: Measures buildContext() throughput for 10 parallel dilemma queries. SLO ETHG-3: mean throughput ≥ 4 500 ops/s.

ETH-5.label: Multi-Round Debate/Runde
ETH-5.note: Measures continueDebate() for one additional debate round including counter-argument generation and storeDebateRound(). Regression gate: throughput regression ≤ 10 %, p95 regression ≤ 15 % vs. this baseline.

ETH-6.label: Metrics Overhead/Decision
ETH-6.note: Measures recordDecision() overhead per call (atomic counter increments + latency accumulation). SLO: ≤ 50 µs per call; lock-free std::atomic path.

regression_policy.description: ETHG-4: any primary benchmark (ETH-1..ETH-6) must not regress more than 8 % vs. this baseline file.
